methodology: Stored measured source SHA-256 values compared to exact committed git blobs through git cat-file --batch, allowing only LF/CRLF checkout representation. A stored SHA must exactly match the committed raw bytes or the deterministic line-ending-only transform. No benchmark rerun, checkout, reset or source edit. The initial raw-only comparison flagged CRLF representations; its output is retained in candy-scope6b-corrective-baseline-bytecheck.json.
